name: Osteomalacia
definition: Defective mineralization of newly formed bone, commonly due to vitamin D deficiency but also caused by phosphate disorders, renal disease or medications.

core: Signs of nutritional or malabsorptive disease

investigations.principle: Laboratory evaluation is central, including calcium/phosphate/ALP/vitamin D and cause-directed testing.
investigations.MRI: MRI can identify occult insufficiency fractures.

amber: Treatment must address calcium/phosphate/renal status rather than vitamin D blindly.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-dhatu kshaya phenotype may be explored, but biochemical mineralization disorder remains explicit.

patientEducation.summary: Defective mineralization of newly formed bone, commonly due to vitamin D deficiency but also caused by phosphate disorders, renal disease or medications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Vitamin D and metabolic bone guidance
